title: Watch: Celebrity Traitors series two kicks off with a wild curveball
originalTitle: Watch: Celebrity Traitors series two kicks off with a wild curveball
content:
Warning spoiler alert.

The new series of Celebrity Traitors has kicked off, with 21 contestants including Bella Ramsey, Maya Jama and Michael Sheen.

But only moments after the game's traitors were selected, a huge curveball was thrown when Richard E Grant did something no one has done on the show before.

BBC culture correspondent Noor Nanji discusses his wild admission, as well as the show's latest twist.

More on this story.
